name: reuse-local-observation-cadence
reason: Use the delivered live-session observation cadence without replacing hillclimb's own stopping condition.
anchor: Each iteration ends in a check before the next begins (the **sequence-verifiable-units** principle skill). If the run is unattended, borrow only the wake mechanism from the Autonomous run playbook (`playbooks/autonomous-run.md`), not its stop rule.
find: If the run is unattended, borrow only the wake mechanism from the Autonomous run playbook (`playbooks/autonomous-run.md`), not its stop rule.
replace: For unattended work, borrow the live-session observation cadence from [Autonomous run](autonomous-run.md), not its stopping condition.

name: resolve-suite-role
reason: Remove hard-coded Cursor model names; only use a configured OMP role, per the generated shared rules.
anchor: - Hand the change to a subagent using your configured hillclimb model (default `claude-opus-5-5-xhigh-fast`) with a tight scope. Pick each subagent's reasoning level for the job, per the Subagents section. Supervise and review the diff rather than typing it (the **guard-the-context-window** principle skill). When several independent hypotheses are live, fan them to parallel subagents, each in its own worktree (the **separate-before-serializing-shared-state** principle skill).
replace: using the configured hillclimb role under poteto-mode Subagents

name: maintain-owned-commit-scope
reason: Keep commit ownership while deferring the actual commit interface to the target project.
anchor: - One commit per accepted fix, staging only the files you changed (`git add <files>`, never `-A`). Log the row either way, kept or reverted.
find: staging only the files you changed (`git add <files>`, never `-A`)
replace: including only the changes owned by the run and following the project’s commit interface
